in_marathi.name: Nandni
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandni हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nandni is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nand', meaning joy or bliss. The name is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity, and is believed to bring happiness and good fortune.
